_comment: Copy this to run_config.json (gitignored) and fill in location before the first real run. run_config.json is what the runner actually reads; this template is the committed, shareable shape so October/December start from the same frozen rules instead of re-deriving them.
logged_out_or_clean_account: claude: persistent account login (no anonymous mode exists), memory/personalization off and cleared, temporary chat per repetition. chatgpt/gemini/perplexity/ai_overview: fresh throwaway browser profile per repetition, fully logged out, no account at all.
